d.title: Koi wa Futago de Warikirenai
d.jp: 恋は双子で割り切れない
d.synopsis: Jun Shirasaki and the Jinguuji sisters are childhood friends and neighbors. When Jun's first girlfriend, the older sister Rumi, breaks up with him, she says something that complicates the three people's relationship, their first loves, and their romance—?
